notesEn: 0.3.69: carry billion-context compaction state across machines + two new notice kinds. A long session keeps working on machine A, but on machine B the next message fails with a context-overflow error: A has DSH native compaction disabled by billion-context (dsh-compaction-gate.js), the real compaction happens on bili outgoing side (a 2.3M surface shrunk to ~160K), and bili records live in a separate SQLite database (%LOCALAPPDATA%\billion-context\sessions\index.db). A pull only restores sessions/attachments/vision_router, so index.db never travels: machine B has neither native compaction nor bili blocks, sends the whole surface and overflows. Fix: new tools/bili-state.mjs (probe/export/import/sync) exporting per-session sessions row + active blocks + summary content to conversations/billion_context/<sessionId>.json (~5MB per long session); capture.ps1 exports after the session block, apply.ps1 imports after restoring sessions, silently skipping when billion-context is absent. The default export deliberately omits sessions.metadata_json (2.4MB cache and NOT NULL, must delete the key so the column falls back to DEFAULT), checkpoint state_hash snapshots (a single row can reach 21.89MB) and message bodies (bili re-ingests them from the session log). Two new sync notice kinds: plugin-missing (a dependency is not installed here; pulling does not install dependencies, run pnpm install in the profile dir or re-run apply.ps1 without -SkipInstall and pull again) and context-state (compaction state did not follow; those sessions may overflow, push again from the main machine or set BILLION_CONTEXT_PLUGIN=0 to fall back to native compaction). Notices stay on the panel until the next sync and are grouped by kind in the post-exit summary.
notes: 0.3.69: 跨机搬运 billion-context 压缩状态 + 同步清单两类新提示。长会话在 A 机能接着聊，拉到 B 机一发消息就报上下文超长：A 机的 DSH 原生 compaction 已被 billion-context 禁用（dsh-compaction-gate.js），真正的压缩是 bili 在出口侧做的（2.3M surface 压成 160K），而 bili 的压缩记录在独立 SQLite（%LOCALAPPDATA%\billion-context\sessions\index.db），同步只带 sessions/attachments/vision_router 三块，index.db 从来没跟着走。于是 B 机既没有原生压缩也没有 bili 压缩记录，把全量 surface 直接发给 provider 就超窗。修复：新增 tools/bili-state.mjs（probe/export/import/sync 四个子命令），按会话导出 sessions 行 + active blocks + summary content，落 conversations/billion_context/<sessionId>.json，约 5MB/长会话；capture.ps1 在会话块之后导出、apply.ps1 在会话还原之后导入，目标机没装 billion-context 时静默跳过。默认不导 sessions.metadata_json（2.4MB 缓存且 NOT NULL，需 delete 让列落 DEFAULT）、不导 checkpoints.state_hash 快照（单条可达 21.89MB）、不导 messages 正文（bili 从会话日志自行 ingest）。同时新增两类同步清单提示：plugin-missing（插件没装到本机，拉取不替你装依赖，要在 profile 里 pnpm install 或去掉 -SkipInstall 重跑 apply.ps1 后再拉一次）与 context-state（压缩状态没跟过来，可能报上下文超长，可在主力机重推或设 BILLION_CONTEXT_PLUGIN=0 让原生压缩兜底），面板常驻显示、post-exit 结束摘要按类分组，标题按实际类别分流不再把插件问题说成「文件没同步」。
